s.n: Peggy Hodgson's sausage rolls with brown sauce
s.note: Flaky puff pastry rolls of pork sausage, onion and sage, brushed with egg and baked golden, with brown sauce
s.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Mix 500g pork sausage mince with 1 finely chopped brown onion, 1 tsp dried sage and 1/2 tsp white pepper. Cut 2 thawed sheets of puff pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and press the seam closed. Cut each roll into 4, set seam side down on a lined tray and brush with beaten egg. Bake for 25 minutes until puffed and deep golden, cool for 5 minutes and serve warm with brown sauce.

s.n: Bill Wilkins's armchair cheese and pickle toasties
s.note: Buttered white bread fried golden around vintage cheddar, brown pickle and a smear of hot mustard
s.how: Butter one side of 8 slices of white bread with 40g soft butter. Turn 4 slices butter side down, spread thinly with 2 tsp hot English mustard, pile on 200g grated vintage cheddar and 4 tbsp brown pickle, then close with the other slices, butter side up. Fry two at a time in a frying pan over medium low heat, pressing with a spatula, for 4 minutes a side until golden and the cheese has melted. Cut into triangles and serve hot.

m.note: Lamb mince braised with carrot, celery and thyme, peas through it, under buttery mash with a cheddar crust
m.how: Cook 1 diced brown onion, 2 diced carrots and 2 diced celery sticks in 1 tbsp oil over medium heat for 10 minutes until soft. Turn up the heat, add 800g lamb mince and brown it well. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tbsp plain flour, then 500ml beef stock, 1 tbsp worcestershire sauce and 1 tsp dried thyme, and simmer for 30 minutes until thick. Meanwhile boil 1.2kg floury potatoes until tender and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk, then season. Stir 150g frozen peas through the mince, season and tip into a 2 litre baking dish. Spread the mash on top, rough it up with a fork, scatter with 60g grated cheddar and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

w.n: Janet's school jam roly-poly with custard
w.note: Soft butter pudding dough rolled around raspberry jam and steam-baked, sliced thick under hot vanilla custard
w.how: Heat the oven to 180C. Rub 125g grated cold butter into 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp caster sugar and a pinch of salt, then stir in 150ml milk to make a soft dough. Roll out to 30cm by 20cm, spread with 150g raspberry jam leaving a 2cm border, roll up from a short side and pinch the ends. Wrap loosely in buttered baking paper and foil, sit on a rack over a roasting tin half full of boiling water and bake for 40 minutes. Meanwhile heat 500ml milk. Whisk 4 egg yolks, 60g caster sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour, pour on the hot milk, return to the pan and stir over low heat until thick, then add 1 tsp vanilla. Rest the pudding for 5 minutes, slice thickly and serve with the custard.

d.note: Whisky with honey and lemon topped with boiling water, a clove-studded lemon slice and cinnamon
d.how: Press 2 cloves into each of 4 lemon slices. Divide 3 tbsp honey, the juice of half a lemon and 160ml whisky between 4 heatproof glasses. Top each with 150ml boiling water and stir, then add a lemon slice and a piece of cinnamon stick and leave for a few minutes. Serve hot.
